QuestInfo.name: First Hunt
QuestInfo.0: You pray to the Fox God and receive the Fox God's blessings. You should talk to #bMoonbeam#k and start your first hunt as a fox.
QuestInfo.1:
Moonbeam tells you that since you got a spirit from receiving Fox God's blessings, you should find your own food.
Go hunt #bCaterpillars#k at the #bEclipse Hill 1#k and gather #b5 Dried Caterpillars#k.
QuestInfo.2: You finished your first hunt thanks to Moonbeam's spirit training. Moonbeam told you to take the caterpillar's legs off so you can eat it, and got very confused when you said you couldn't do it.
